text:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT P1 — Dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-west-1-7' experiencing sustained token latency > 2s and elevated queue depths. Triggered autoscale alarms at 1749998879. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated-autoscale

oncall_eli: I'm on pager. grabbing logs + checking pool health

ops_maya: watching metrics — sudden spike in concurrent streams from customer: partner-ztc. start_time ~1749998600. TPS up 6x

infra_rob: quick mitigation options: 1) toggle pool autoscale to conservative (reduce burst headroom) 2) temporarily disable burst_mode for pool 3) apply per-customer soft rate-limit on partner-ztc 4) increase min_replicas to avoid cold-start latencies

oncall_eli: prioritized: soft rate-limit + burst_mode off. want to keep availability. preparing commands

infra_rob: command to flip burst mode:
```
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-eu-west-1-7 --set burst_mode=false
```
will run after partner rate-limit in place

sre_jin: setting per-customer limit now — bumping partner-ztc to 40r/s global slice, then backfill with quota cap
```
redwoodctl quotas set --customer partner-ztc --rate 40rps --scope global
```
applied — monitoring

acct_leah: FYI support ticket 92341 from partner-ztc mentioning a batch job. I've DM'd their eng lead to throttle upstream if possible :eyes:

ops_maya: observed queue depth falling ~20% after rate-limit applied. latency still elevated for in-flight. recommend set min_replicas=6 to stabilize KV cache hit rates

infra_rob: running:
```
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-eu-west-1-7 --min-replicas=6
```
started scale up, should finish in ~90s

oncall_eli: toggled burst_mode and min_replicas done. switching autoscale policy to conservative to reduce oscillation:
```
redwoodctl autoscale policy apply dedicated-eu-west-1-7 --policy conservative --cooldown 60s
```

product_ana: are any customers impacted by degraded throughput aside from partner-ztc? ops_maya?

ops_maya: small number of high-concurrency customers saw transient 5xxs during the spike window. most recovered after limits. we flagged 5 customers for engagement

oncall_eli: running live traffic steering to push non-critical traffic to fallback model variant v1-small to free up GPUS for real-time paths
```
redwoodctl routing patch --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-7 --route "non-critical" --target model:v1-small --percent 35
```
applied, observing


infra_rob: autoscale completed; min_replicas active. latency trending down to ~600ms from 2.1s pre-mitigation. queue depth normalized

sre_jin: adding temporary telemetry annotation for the incident and creating an eval to measure quality impact from routing -> fallback model

acct_leah: notified partner-ztc of temporary rate-limits and asked for ETA on batch mitigation

oncall_eli: summary: mitigations applied in order: 1) partner rate-limit 2) burst_mode disabled 3) min_replicas increased 4) autoscale to conservative 5) traffic steering to fallback model. System stabilized at 1749999020. No ongoing P1 customer outages, continued monitoring for 30m

product_ana: thanks. please schedule postmortem and include decision timeline + ETA for permanent controls (auto per-customer gating)

infra_rob: filing incident ticket and will attach commands/logs

incidents-bot: Incident marked "mitigation in place" by oncall_eli at 1749999030

oncall_eli: I'll handoff to second-line at 1749999045 for watch. leaving notes in pager duty and the ticket.

sre_jin: assigned follow-up action items: root-cause triage (partner batch), evaluate auto-per-customer gating, improve alert thresholds to detect stepwise TPS jumps.

acct_leah: closing loop with partner once they acked throttling their job. thanks team :thumbsup:

oncall_eli: resolved for now, marking thread for postmortem.
